items.title: A spectral bijection lifting specializations or generalizations is a homeomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a spectral bijection between spectral spaces which lifts generalizations, respectively specializations, is a homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 4821-4830, label lemma-spectral-bijective). The proof (source lines 4832-4848) first gets a homeomorphism for the constructible topology, then shows that the image of a quasi-compact open is constructible and stable under specialization, hence open, and records the dual argument (proof lines 4832-4847). The specialization argument is the substance. H3.
